disposition_reason: EFSA novel food opinion printing applicant batch analyses of water lentil powder (Lemna minor and Wolffia globosa) for arsenic, cadmium, lead, mercury and other elements in six batches, plus trace elements in two further batches.

study.design: Regulatory safety assessment with applicant-supplied batch-to-batch analyses
study.origin: Co-culture of Wolffia globosa and Lemna minor grown in open-field hydroponic lined basins, Florida (US)
study.method: AOAC 993.14 mod. (ICP-MS) for Table 1; in-house ICP-AES/OES for Table 2
study.lod_text: Reporting limits appear as '<' values: As not censored; Cd <0.01; Pb <0.02; Hg <0.01 to <0.015; Cr <0.200; Co <0.050; Se <0.30; Sn <0.15 mg/kg
study.qa: Laboratories accredited to ISO/IEC 17025:2005; no CRM data printed
